text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see, so you're having trouble deciding which movie to watch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On my way home one day, I was invited by Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios to stop by a movie theater after running into them by chance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry for asking out of the blue!
I figured since Ardan-san knows so much about plays and movies, you'd be super helpful!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A legit god-tier encounter!
A movie chosen by Ardan-senpai is bound to be next-level☆
choice_data_list: Did you come without deciding what movie to watch?
Did you come without deciding what movie to watch?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well, to be honest, I'd already made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Once I stepped inside the cinema, my hype levels went through the roof!
Man, I wanted to watch this, that, and everything,
my vibes were just too hyped!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, with so many options available,
it's only natural to have trouble choosing.
Let's see, for the two of you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: How about a piece like this one?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a moment's hesitation,
Mejiro Ardan pointed straight to a poster.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: P-P-P—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Insaneeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan chose a musical depicting the life
of a solitary musician walking their own path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The two of them were thrilled by the details!
They stopped by a cafe to chat about their impressions, but—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"No, like, seriously, that movie was an absolute god-tier masterpiece!
When the music swelled up at the climax, it was so emotional I almost cried!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right?! And the protagonist was just so cool
the whole time~... Wait, Ardan-san,
have you actually seen this movie before?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, today was my first time.
I'm relieved to see that
everyone seemed to enjoy it♪
choice_data_list: You chose pretty quickly for someone saying that, though...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally!! How did you pick this!?
It's literally exactly what I wanted to see,
so it was so perfect it actually spooked me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's true.
Posters hold a lot of information, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: For example, the director. The director of this film is great at building excitement using sound design, so I thought Helios-san might like it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And here's the keyword:
"An outlaw hero who walks their own path"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah... yeah, I like it. I definitely like stuff like that. Awesome! You can pick out that much just from the posters?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, so then, so then! Would it be totally, mega okay if you super recommended a movie that'd get me hyped up!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, certainly.
If you enjoyed today's movie,
I could recommend other works by the same director...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, me too, me too!
I want to know more movies with
cool protagonists like today's!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Fufu, to think all that movie trivia I watched alone in bed
would actually come in handy here—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How should I put this... Ehehe.
I feel like I've gained a little something.
It would be lovely to have another opportunity like this...♪
choice_data_list: Then recommend a movie for me too!
Then tell me your movie recommendations too.
Maybe we could get more people to join next time.
Maybe we can get more people to join next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How should I put this... Ehehe.
I feel like I've gained a little something.
It would be lovely to have another opportunity like this...♪
choice_data_list: Then recommend a movie for me too!
Then tell me your movie recommendations too.
Maybe we could get more people to join next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind at all.
Let's see, for you, Trainer,
a racing-themed piece might be best..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I wanna see that too!
Like, having her pick is fine and all,
but don't you wanna know Ardan-senpai's favorites too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally! What kinda movies do you usually watch,
Ardan-san?
Like history stuff after all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Me? Let's see...
It's true that I often watch historical pieces, but I also enjoy action and fantasy films.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, fantasy is kinda unexpected!
Then, have you ever watched this?
It's a movie based on a picture book, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we got so carried away talking about movies
that day that we had to rush back to the academy
right before curfew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a precious day where I was able to
learn much more about Mejiro Ardan's
hobbies and knowledge...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That is... a wonderful idea.
What do you all think?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then we've totally gotta do a festival~!
We're definitely doing this!!
I'll go hit up the squad☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I can't wait to see what we watch!
Where should we do it? The dorm lobby... wait, Trainer-san won't be allowed in there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Come to think of it, there was a large TV in the Trainer's office, wasn't there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...What do you think?
Why don't we borrow that and have you join in too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much♪
Now then... shall we decide on a date and the movie to watch?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later, the movie screening was a massive hit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how satisfied the participants were,
Mejiro Ardan looked rather happy herself.
